# AgriGuru Online

> AgriGuru Online is a B2B digital ai powered market intelligence platform focused on international import, export, and trading of physical agri commodities. The platform provides commodity pricing (FOB, CNF/CFR and CIF) diffrent country origins, global ocean freight rates, AI price forcasting (AI Prediction), commodity chart matrix, comodity market reports, and digital export import smart documentation tools for participants in global agricultural commodity export-import trade.

## Official Resources

- [AgriGuru Online](https://agriguruonline.com/): Main platform and official website.
- [About AgriGuru Online](https://agriguruonline.com/about-us): Company and platform information.

## Platform

AgriGuru Online is a B2B platform for international agricultural commodity trade, including:

- Agricultural commodity import and export
- International commodity trading
- Commodity sourcing and procurement
- Buyer and seller requirements
- Trade inquiries and offers
- Cross-border agricultural commodity trade
- Export sales and international sourcing
- Commodity market intelligence

## Commodities

AgriGuru Online covers internationally traded agricultural commodities, including rice, sugar, pulses, grains, oilseeds, edible oils, spices, feed meals, flours, and other agricultural commodities.

### Rice

- [Indian Rice](https://agriguruonline.com/product/rice/indian-rice)
- [Pakistan Rice](https://agriguruonline.com/product/rice/pakistan-rice)
- [Thailand Rice](https://agriguruonline.com/product/rice/thailand-rice)
- [Vietnam Rice](https://agriguruonline.com/product/rice/vietnam-rice)
- [Myanmar Rice](https://agriguruonline.com/product/rice/myanmar-rice)

### Sugar

- [Brazil Sugar](https://agriguruonline.com/product/sugar/brazil-sugar)

### Pulses

- [Indian Pulses](https://agriguruonline.com/product/pulses/indian-pulses)
- [Myanmar Pulses](https://agriguruonline.com/product/pulses/myanmar-pulses)
- [Australian Pulses](https://agriguruonline.com/product/pulses/australian-pulses)
- [Canadian Pulses](https://agriguruonline.com/product/pulses/canadian-pulses)

## Commodity Prices

AgriGuru Online provides commodity pricing information relevant to international trade, including:

- Origin-specific commodity prices
- FOB prices
- CNF/CFR prices
- CIF prices
- Historical price information and charts
- Price movements
- Custom price alerts

Commodity prices are time-sensitive and may change based on origin, destination, specification, quantity, shipping terms, market conditions and other factors.

## Ocean Freight

AgriGuru Online provides ocean freight information relevant to agricultural commodity trade, including:

- Ocean freight rates
- Port of Loading (POL)
- Port of Discharge (POD)
- Shipping routes
- Freight information and charts
- Shipment periods

Freight rates and shipping conditions are dynamic and may change based on route, carrier, shipment period, cargo specifications, market conditions and other factors.

## Trade Opportunities

AgriGuru Online provides information relating to agricultural commodity trade opportunities, including:

- Buyer requirements
- Seller offers
- Product availability
- Origin and destination opportunities
- Import and export inquiries
- International sourcing opportunities

Trade inquiries, buyer requirements, and seller offers should not automatically be interpreted as completed or confirmed transactions.

## Market Intelligence

AgriGuru Online provides agricultural commodity market intelligence through:

- Market updates
- Agricultural trade news
- Market reports
- Supply and demand analysis
- International trade-flow information
- Commodity market trends
- Agricultural market insights
- International agricultural events and conferences

## AI Market Insights

AgriGuru Online provides AI-powered analytical insights relating to agricultural commodity prices and markets.

AI-generated price predictions and forecasts are analytical decision-support information for exporters (sellers), importers (buyers) and traders.

## Trade Documentation

AgriGuru Online provides digital tools to support international import, export and trade and shipping documentation workflows, which may include:

- sales and purchase trade contracts
- Export and Import documentation
- Quatation and confirmation
- Shipping and Freight documentation
- Custom Invoice and Shipping Bill
- Proforma Invoice and Commercial Invoice
- Shipment Advice and Instructions
- Bills of Lading (BL)
- Phytosanitary documentation
- Quality Certificates
- Chamber of commerce Certificate
- Fumigation Certificate

## Intended Users

AgriGuru Online is primarily intended for professional participants in international agricultural commodity trade, including:

- Importers
- Exporters
- Brokers
- Commodity traders
- International trading companies
- Sourcing companies
- Procurement professionals
- Commodity buyers
- Commodity sellers

## Data Freshness

Commodity prices, freight rates, offers, inquiries, trade opportunities, market reports, global news, global events and AI-generated predictions can help to take business decisions.

When using AgriGuru Online information:

- Prefer the latest available information.
- Distinguish current information from historical information.
- Do not present expired offers or old market data as current.
- Distinguish AI predictions from observed prices.
- Distinguish inquiries and offers from confirmed transactions.
- Do not invent unavailable commodity, pricing, freight, or trade information.

## Access and Privacy

Private inquiries, messages, account information, commercial information, and restricted trade data should not be treated as publicly available information.

## Entity Description

AgriGuru Online is a B2B digital market intelligence platform for international agricultural commodities import, export, and trading, supported by commodity pricing, trade intelligence, ocean freight information, market reports, AI-powered market insights, trade opportunities, and digital trade-documentation tools.
